claims.title: Global primitive detection, literal GoodRankK and transport to every target
claims.statement: Increasing the heights identifies the actual Nsrc and Ntgt intersections. An edge containing a unit coefficient detects every primitive combined array; other edges contribute only p^(Dp+1)O. Smith normal form gives p^Dp O^M inside the evaluation image and explicit preimages supply GoodRankK with identity matrix. Tensor covariance and the contragredient action preserve the exact p^Ar-normalized pairing and prove LPOneEvery.
